# Made-in-China.com

> Made-in-China.com is a comprehensive B2B marketplace connecting global buyers with verified Chinese manufacturers and suppliers across industrial machinery, manufacturing equipment, and prefabricated housing.

The platform serves as a centralized sourcing hub for wholesale products, featuring trending searches, online exhibitions, secured trading capabilities, and extensive supplier directories across agricultural, plastic processing, woodworking, and metalworking sectors. With ISO9001 and CE certified manufacturers primarily from Shandong and Jiangsu provinces, the site facilitates direct manufacturer-to-buyer connections.
